findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Monoidal/Cartesian/Over.lean:68-69 `@[simp] lemma tensorUnit_hom : (𝟙_ (Over X)).hom = 𝟙 X := rfl`; `grep -rn trivial_hom TauCeti/` outside Trivial.lean returns nothing, and Trivial.lean itself never uses it (`trivial_dim` goes through `toScheme`/`Over.tensorUnit_left`).
findings.fix: Delete `trivial_hom`; the simp set already closes it.
findings.issue: `trivial_hom` is the composite of the `@[simp]` lemma `trivial_toOver` (line 68) and Mathlib's `@[simp] Over.tensorUnit_hom`; simp already rewrites `(trivial K).toOver.hom` to `𝟙 (Spec (.of K))`. It has no consumer in the repo. This is exactly the defect for which `trivial_toScheme` was deleted last round.

findings.evidence: Hom.lean:122 `abbrev Hom.toSchemeHom {A B} (f : A ⟶ B) : A.toScheme ⟶ B.toScheme := (Hom.toOverHom f).left`; Hom.lean:128 `@[simp] lemma Hom.toSchemeHom_mk' ... = f.left`; Trivial.lean:104 proof is literally `toSchemeHom_mk' _`. `grep -rn toSchemeHom_toTrivial TauCeti/` finds no use.
findings.fix: Delete `Hom.toSchemeHom_toTrivial`; keep only `Hom.toOverHom_toTrivial` as the interface lemma for the unexposed `toTrivial`.
findings.issue: `Hom.toSchemeHom_toTrivial` is derivable by simp from the `@[simp]` lemma `Hom.toOverHom_toTrivial` two lines above, since `Hom.toSchemeHom` is a reducible abbrev for `(toOverHom f).left` (Hom.lean:122-123). Both are specializations of the existing `Hom.toOverHom_mk'`/`Hom.toSchemeHom_mk'` (Hom.lean:91, 128), and neither `toSchemeHom_toTrivial` nor `toOverHom_toTrivial` has any consumer.

summary: The new geometric-integrality instance and the terminality API are genuinely new, and the prior refactor findings are fixed. Two leftover lemmas are still composites of existing @[simp] lemmas with no consumers, the same defect class as the deleted `trivial_toScheme`.
